content.text:
I submitted index 3 (Sb fraction 0.19) as the best composition. At 0.107%, it had the highest EQE of the five compositions I measured.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.12 | 0.067 |
| **3** | **0.19** | **0.107** |
| 8 | 0.31 | 0.069 |
| 15 | 0.52 | 0.031 |
| 21 | 0.69 | 0.022 |

- **Trend:** EQE rose steadily as Sb fell from 0.69 to 0.19, then dropped again at 0.12. The best composition on the line is therefore probably somewhere between about 0.15 and 0.25 Sb.
- **Structure:** XRD on indices 0 and 3 shows the same rutile-type phase. Index 0 also has one extra weak peak at Q ≈ 0.80 Å⁻¹, which could be a second phase and may explain its lower EQE. I didn't check this against simulated patterns, so the phase assignments are my reading of the peak positions.
- **Not measured:** The EQE budget ran out before I could test the neighbours of index 3 (indices 1, 2, 4 and 5, Sb 0.14–0.23). One of them could beat index 3. I used 2 of the 5 XRD measurements.
